items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Used to come in to sit down and jam on 52nd Street when he was in town...

ctx.x: So around that time in the mid-forties when you did the Metronome All-stars date you recorded with other well known musicians, one was with Buck Clayton. Do you have anything to say about him?
--- I used to know him. Used to come in to sit down and jam on 52nd Street when he was in town...
You made some recordings with Billie Holiday around that time also.
